name: Caddy
tagline: The web server that gets HTTPS right
description: Powerful, extensible web server with automatic HTTPS. WhyNotHost generates its config for you.
compose:
services:
  caddy:
    image: caddy:alpine
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${{cfg.port}}:80"
      - "127.0.0.1:${{cfg.https_port}}:443"
    volumes:
      - ./Caddyfile:/etc/caddy/Caddyfile
      - ./data:/data
    restart: unless-stopped
